decision.reason: [ev-518a56c0e2c1] is only a bug-fix title ("scheduling flake due to nodepool readiness"). It does not say whether the flake was in the product's runtime scheduling or only in its tests. Nearby items such as [ev-aa6e55e47c2f] (an E2E test fix) and [ev-f21609ff075e] ("scheduling zone-id flake") suggest it could be a test-only flake. If so, no environment is exposed, and the proposed runtime-behavior-gap exposure claims more than the evidence supports. We need the PR #6491 description or diff to show whether runtime code changed and under what conditions the flake affected scheduling.
